caveats: ⚑ Metal σ is modeled as a 0/1 resource pool. The restore block (fullBurstEnd + ownBurstGate 'cast') is an interpretation of "has cast Burst Skill before Full Burst ends"; confirm ownBurstGate composes with a fullBurstEnd trigger in the engine, else re-key the restore to a burstCast trigger (identical cadence whenever she bursts every rotation, off-by-one-cycle when she skips one).

⚑ perResource on burstGenPct assumes the live-resource buff path is read by the gauge accumulator. Fallback if not: a plain passive burstGenPct 70.4, which over-credits gauge during the window where σ is consumed (FB-enter → FB-end).

⚑ S2's Charge Time ▼ 0.18 sec is NOT modeled: no flat charge-time primitive (schema has only chargeSpeedPct) and no "longest basic Charge Time" target kind. If enacted, chargeSpeedPct ≈ 100 × 0.18 / baseChargeSec on the single charge-weapon ally.

⚑ S1 team heal read as RECURRING every 10 normal attacks; only the S1 ATK line carries an explicit "Activates once per battle". The heal AMOUNT (2.04% of caster final Max HP) is not modeled — the engine has no HP pool; the recovery EVENT is the modeled part.
⚑ Cadence tuple (ammo 60 / reloadFrames 121 / AR pulls-per-sec) is datamined and unverified for this unit.
⚑ Burst DoT: crit left OFF (global DOT_CRIT gate) and noFb unset (Full Burst applied by tick timing). Both are measured-only fields.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Authored from kit text only, with no board exposure. Metal γ (S1) is a permanent self ATK ▲58.08%: its sole removal condition is an ally going out of action, which cannot occur in v1 (no HP pool, immortal roster), so the γ status gate on the S1 team heal is likewise always satisfied and the heal is modeled as an ungated hitCount:10 recovery event to all allies (event only — no HP amount; it exists to feed on-recovery consumers). Metal σ (S2) is modeled as a 0/1 resource: initial 1, read live by a perResource burstGenPct passive (σ=1 → +70.4%, σ=0 → 0), consumed by the Full-Burst-enter block that grants Attack Damage ▲21.12% and ATK ▲63.36% for 10s, and restored at Full-Burst end when the owner cast her own burst that rotation. Burst = a self Sustained Damage ▲52.8% for 10s plus one 396%-of-final-ATK sustained DoT ticking every 1s for 10s (one appended instance per cast). The S2 Full-Burst-enter Charge Time ▼0.18 sec to the longest-basic-charge-time ally is deliberately unmodeled — the schema carries neither a flat charge-time primitive nor that target kind.
